_about: Corrections to QuestieDB for WoW Forever, from what players see in game. gen_route.py applies them before planning. drop: the quest isn't in the game (or not worth routing). preQuestGroup / preQuestSingle: quests that must be handed in first. Each entry says who saw what, and when.

98096.note: Sisters In Duty: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade only offers Eyes of the Sentinels (98067) until it's done. Seen in game by Gary, 14 Nov 2026.

3763.note: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm (innkeeper breadcrumb): Innkeeper Saelienne offers no quest in game. Seen 14 Nov 2026; Forever seems to have removed the innkeeper breadcrumbs.

3789.note: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm, same breadcrumb from another innkeeper: removed like 3763 (unverified, same Forever change).

3790.note: Assisting Arch Druid Staghelm, same breadcrumb from another innkeeper: removed like 3763 (unverified, same Forever change).

4244.noAccept: needs a Mithril Casing (made by engineers - Auction House) or a drop from Clunk in Searing Gorge
4244.note: Chasing A-Me 01 (part 2): A-Me 01 offers it when you hand in part 1; it needs a Mithril Casing, which nothing in Un'Goro drops. Not worth a trip. Seen in game by Gary, 14 Nov 2026.

4245.note: Chasing A-Me 01 (escort, part 3): needs 4244 first, which is off the route.

95934.note: Proof of Profit: the Cubic Draconia crystals poke up from the dirt in the dragon cave Gelinda Coppergleam stands in (quest text: 'in these caves'). No database places them. Gary, 14 Nov 2026: 'its in the cave'.

95982.noAccept: needs 10 Briny Seafood Stew (Cooking 200 - recipe from Fimbo Greasemitz in Riverglades - or the Auction House)
95982.note: Not My Circus: 10 Briny Seafood Stew, cooked only (2 Murloc Eye, Tender Crab Meat, Hot Spices each). Not worth routing. A friend of Gary's was sent to it with nowhere to go, 14 Nov 2026.

89228.noAccept: means fishing up 10 Winter Squid (or buying them)
89228.note: Winter Frontier Fishery: a fishing quest, not offered by Berdun Cliffbrew to Gary (level 53, Fishing 330, Gettin' Buzzed in his log). Not worth routing either way. Seen in game 14 Nov 2026.

89015.note: Deadliest Catch: Berdun Cliffbrew doesn't offer it (Gary, 14 Nov 2026) and ForeverChanges has no page for it - probably not in the game.

92100.note: Anywhere But Here: the Veteran of the Third War isn't at 20.4,59.4 (Questie/ForeverChanges). He stands at Mourning's Rest, Mount Hyjal ~24.1,55.0, among the Forgotten Soldiers (Blight No More); Gary got the quest from him there, 16 Nov 2026. Giver moved (npcs). A Wowhead comment says the later chain is summoned with the Embroidered Scabbard at ~8,46 and can bug out.

96550.note: Battle Recall: 'War Veteran's story told' had no location (Gary 18 Nov 2026). Use the scabbard at 8,46 and speak to the spirit (Wowhead Forever comment 13 Nov 2026; Veteran of the Third War 8.8,46.5).
96550.tip: Right-click the Embroidered Scabbard in your bags at 8.8,46.5, then talk to the spirit that appears.

93567.note: Ends Meet: from the Veteran of the Third War spirit (27.5,50.9), whose first quest Gary couldn't find (16 Nov 2026). Off the route until someone sees how he appears.

96558.note: Soldier's Solace: from the Veteran of the Third War spirit (27.5,50.9); off the route like Ends Meet.

96674.note: Ewe Wandered Off (Mirt, Elderwild 15.9,52.7): not offered at 56 (16 Nov 2026, was dropped); offered straight after Final Death (92591) was handed in (Gary 17 Nov 2026) - back on, after Final Death.
96674.tip: Click a sheep to grab it (several at once is fine), walk them into Mirt's pen with them close behind - and don't jump, it drops them.

95753.note: Challenge of the Desert Wolf: a shaman class quest (ForeverChanges files it under Shaman; the Odd Totem offers nothing to other classes). Gary (mage) was sent to it, 15 Nov 2026.

94504.note: Barkskin Burrow camp (Mount Hyjal ~21,79) is hostile until the Barkskin reputation chain: Brerufa's Balance Through Strength -> Of Friend and Fur -> Osi Mistpaw's Sweetpaw Jam -> Meet the Elders. Barkskin Beginnings is 'raise your reputation with the Barkskin Burrow to Neutral'. QuestieDB links none of these quests to the chain, so the route sent Gary into the red camp first (16 Nov 2026). Placed after Meet the Elders (inferred).

96296.note: Fetid Corruption: QuestieDB gives the quest-start Corrupted Growth (651409, one spot) as the objective. The ones to loot are Corrupted Growth 651430, 14 spots around 47-53, 55-61 (Wowhead Forever). Gary, 17 Nov 2026: 'no fetid corruption'.

93747.note: Violence Into Verdure: the three wrecks ('Ruined War Machinery' objects 642327/642498/642501) have no spawns in any database. Gary found all three on 17 Nov 2026: Ruined Catapult 62.8,83.0, Ruined Flying Machine 66.2,83.2, Ruined Ballista 66.2,79.1. They're a few steps apart, so one area covers them (a single spot for just the catapult had sent him back to it after he'd done it).
93747.tip: Use the Bag of Enchanted Seeds standing right against each Ruined War Machinery wreck.

95611.note: Rites of Respect: bury the remains at Ketharas' shrine ('to the west ... a simple pair of standing stones'). No database places it; a Wowhead Forever comment (13 Nov 2026) gives 66, 84, the Druidic Shrine 'Standing Stones' (object 581744). Added 17 Nov 2026 when Gary took the quest. Confirmed by Gary 17 Nov 2026: buried at 66.6, 84.2.
95611.tip: Use the Sacred Stag Bundle at the two standing stones.

91696.tip: Only after Barkskin Breakout: she's caged until then. Escort: she walks from 31.5,58.6 south-west to about 24,63. Not there? Someone's escorting her - wait for her to come back.

95316.note: The Experimental Method: the four Ashen Reign workstations (no database has them). Gary 17 Nov 2026: Vessel ~46,69.7, Disease 46.5,67.3, Alchemy 44.3,68.3, Slime 42.9,71.9 - the warlock camp the Curious Crow means. One area for all four.
95316.tip: Use the pinecones on the four Ashen Reign workstations in the warlock camp.

93383.note: Contents Under Pressure: done at the Personal Survival Pack itself - stand by it through the radio's 30-second countdown and fight off what it attracts (Wowhead Forever objectives; Gary 17 Nov 2026).
93383.tip: Stay by the pack through the radio's 30-second countdown and kill what it brings.

90865.note: Eyes of the Watchers (Eluneth): not offered until The Western Post (91881) is handed in to Sefira - Gary 17 Nov 2026 confirmed. Tip (Wowhead comment): the watchers are the gargoyles (Eternal Sentry), stand near them to pull; 2 eyes each, 8 needed.
90865.tip: The watchers are the gargoyles: stand near one to pull it. 2 eyes each.

92591.tip: Light the bone pile at 27,57 with Sefira's torch - the Scourge Reanimator only comes then.

91770.tip: Use the Herbal Soil Poultice on Fraxinus - he's friendly, don't attack him.

93615.tip: Brie: chasing butterflies at 41.7,36.6. Solstice: stealthed on the bottom rock of the Cradle waterfall, 38.4,47.2. Whisperfur: broken wall under the small bridge by Tyrus Blackhorn, 27,62.
93615.note: Kits and Cats (Shalla'kal): three cats far apart - Brie 41.6,36.4, Solstice 38.4,47.2, Whisperfur 27,62 (Wowhead Forever + a player comment, 17 Nov 2026). Three spots each so the addon makes a stop per cat.

96959.tip: Southeast Bonfire is in the Defiling Hound camp (54.9,39.8) - light it while you kill the hounds. South Bonfire is at 49.2,36, just south of Yashiro.
96959.note: Blademaster's Bonfires (Yashiro): two bonfire objects, South 656668 at 49.2,36 and Southeast 656669 at 54.9,39.8 (Wowhead Forever, 17 Nov 2026). No objective location in QuestieDB, so the plan accepted and handed in with nothing between.

96931.tip: Jereman only appears when you touch the Crow Effigy: a tiny golden square floating just above the left rail at the start of the bridge (41.4,45). Zoom the camera all the way in to see it.
96931.note: Heading Up the Mountain: Jereman is summoned from a pixel-sized effigy on the bridge (Wowhead Forever comments, 17 Nov 2026).

96957.tip: Sun-Bleached Bonepiles lie all over the ruins around Marrosis (22-27, 46-57), where you kill for Stolen Life.
96957.note: Bone Sweet Bone: Sun-Bleached Bonepile, object 656518, 26 spawns (Wowhead Forever).

96971.tip: Abandoned Supplies are scattered through Dae'gun (49-60, 31-44), the Defiling Hound area.
96971.note: To Outfox a Demon: Abandoned Supplies, object 656604, 20 spawns (Wowhead Forever).

92335.tip: Azgalor's Remains, in the ruins of Dae'gun at 49.3,34.4.
92335.note: Ashes of the Legion Ascent: Azgalor's Remains, object 650227 (Wowhead Forever).

96003.tip: Use the Eye of Endless Influence on each elite first (it becomes "the Feeble" / "the Weak"); killed at full power it gives no credit. Mazzogore 50.5,39.5, Bethra'zel 58.5,32.5.
96003.note: Drawing Down the Malevolent: weaken Bethra'zel and Mazzogore with the quest item or no credit (Wowhead Forever comment, 17 Nov 2026).

97010.tip: Climb the Horde Mage Tower in Dae'gun to the very top, stand on the little axe on the ledge and throw the Explosive Runeshard at the ground below. Keep throwing; after a demon hunter's talk it counts.
97010.note: Blind Vengeance: tower position not in any database yet; tip from Wowhead Forever comments (17 Nov 2026).

92017.tip: Squallclimbers and Chimaeroks roam all of Hyjal; both are thick in the northeast around the Blackthorne camps (69-83, 22-46), so fill both here while you do the Blackthorne quests.
92017.note: Cleansing Winds: both mobs spawn zone-wide, which made six stops across Mount Hyjal (Gary 17 Nov). Boxed to the northeast, where both are dense and the Blackthorne quests are.

92959.tip: Click the Corrupted Tree at 63.2,74.1 to summon Sunderbark (elite 56, can be feared and stunned). Kill him, then use his corpse to plant the seed.
92959.note: The Dying Ancients: Corrupted Tree object 659742 at 63.2,74.1 summons Sunderbark 248709 (Wowhead Forever comments, 17 Nov 2026).

96435.tip: Throw the warlock bones on the Bone Pile at 40.7,80.2 (follow the road west from Felflick).
96435.note: A Fitting End: objective 'Warlock Bones Thrown on Slime Altar' had no location, so it was listed without a stop (Gary 18 Nov 2026). Bone Pile object 652449 at 40.7,80.2 (Wowhead Forever comments).

96979.tip: Fill the gourd at the falls up the climb from Galvinquam (32.9,54.4), then come back to him.

93127.note: Summit Sentries: QuestieDB gives no prerequisite. Gary 18 Nov 2026, level 59 at Tiala with A Thorn in the Paw and Cult Closure (both hers) still open: not offered. Inferred: needs both handed in first.

93422.note: Blackthorne Blackout: QuestieDB gives no prerequisite. Gary 18 Nov 2026: not offered by Rhylin. A Wowhead Forever comment (17 Nov) says it comes after 'the previous ones' and takes a rod they gave - inferred: Summit Sentries (sentinel stones) first.

npcs._about: NPC positions Questie's Forever data has wrong. Each applies only where the data has the stated wrong spot (from), so other quests of the same NPC are untouched. to = [uiMap, x, y]; null x/y = position unknown (the addon learns it when you talk to them).

Ketharas.note: Questie files him in Moonglade; ForeverChanges' quest pages (Seeds for a New Season) put him in Mount Hyjal 73.3, 81.7, and Gary did his quests in Hyjal. 15 Nov 2026.

Veteran of the Third War.note: He stands at Mourning's Rest ~24.1,55.0 (Gary got Anywhere But Here from him, 16 Nov 2026); nobody at 20.4,59.4. Only the 20.4,59.4 spot moves; his other spots (8.8,46.5 scabbard, 27.5,50.9) stay.
